business_problem: In Nigeria, low crop yields, along with limited access to finance and training, can make it difficult for smallholder farmers to thrive. Social enterprise Babban Gona , which means "Great Farm" in Hausa, is working to address these challenges.
solution_summary: Babban Gona migrates to Google Cloud and innovates with Vertex AI and Gemini to help smallholder farmers double their crop yield. The pivotal moment came when Babban Gona wanted to build a computer vision model to provide tailored advice to smallholders. This required advanced AI training - something its old infrastructure couldn't support. Already working with TensorFlow , a Google proprietary library, the team decided to experiment with Vertex AI and found it was optimized for its model training. Our positive experience training models in Vertex AI led us towards our full migration to Google Cloud. It had everything we needed in one place, was easier to use than other providers, and significantly improved our reliability and scalability. With security features baked in, it was the obvious choice.

metrics: 5x increase in technical capabilities thanks to platform scalability
By analyzing historical data, BigQuery helps field agents provide farmers with recommendations on everything from the type of crops to plant to the optimal credit amount a smallholder can receive.
With the scalability of its Google Cloud infrastructure, Babban Gona can now focus on expanding its reach to achieve its long-term goal of supporting 50 million smallholders by 2043.
This will bring a new revenue stream to the organization, while further extending its positive impact across Nigeria.
